other_conditions: Applicant must be a native of Chhattisgarh
Applicant must be a family member of the deceased primary breadwinner
The deceased must have been the primary breadwinner of the family
The death must be due to natural, unnatural, or accidental causes
If there is more than one earning member, assistance is given only for the death of the member whose income contributes the most to the family
The term “family” includes husband, wife, minor children, unmarried daughters, and dependent parents
benefits_summary: Eligible families receive a lump‑sum payment of ₹20,000.
